cohort: The study included 453 pregnant individuals (126 with pregestational diabetes mellitus and 327 with gestational diabetes mellitus) who presented in the late preterm period with concern for preterm delivery.
finding: Late preterm ACS administration in diabetic pregnancies was not associated with increased neonatal hypoglycemia or improvements in composite respiratory morbidity, though a complete course was associated with reductions in supplemental oxygen use, mechanical ventilation, and respiratory distress syndrome.
gest_age: Babies born in the late preterm period, with gestational age at delivery used as an adjustment variable.
